observed_result: After applying the mmstart prefix the screen stayed black, no Com Error/Fatal appeared, no map loaded, and 0x632462 did not hit. The prefix was therefore not the missing piece.
interpretation: 0x62F840 builds the argument text for a match-service command (sv_resetServer; ...; map <map>; roomChatChannelID) and hands it to the client command path. The leading 'mmstart ' is stripped by the caller (esi = eax+7), but the client image has no standalone 'mmstart' C-string and no matching Cbuf command registration; the only mmstart strings are the service format strings at 0xDC6800/0xDC6888/0xDC6948. The room start path is a request to the match service, not a local listen-server launch. Adding the prefix cannot create the missing server.
cleanup: Run terminated by the coordinator after the observation. tools/net_rollback.ps1 reported no guard/client processes, no CODOL WFP filters, a firewall baseline match, and working DNS/loopback/ports.
direction_change: Stop trying to make the room.startgame Cbuf text start a local match. The next branch is either (a) an offline PVE/training UI path that may load a map without the match service, or (b) a local service implementation using the existing 319/server319 stack. The first is cheaper and will be attempted next.
